text:
Yes, there is a tree-cover loss candidate, but it is not yet corroborated.

Hansen GFC (v1.13) shows 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025 within the 345.6 ha property, about 3.9% of its area. The JRC 2020 forest map agrees with this at 0.98, and the area is in a native forest context. About 227 ha (65.7%) of the property was forest in 2020.

Limits:
- 2025 is the latest year in the series. Persistence can't be confirmed until a later year is observed, so the event stays "pending corroboration."
- Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as harvesting a plantation, so this doesn't show deforestation or land-use change.
- The cause (harvest, fire, storm, clearing) is unknown.
- Legality or authorization is not established.
- This is not a compliance finding, such as EUDR status.

The MGAP 2021 source was not available.
